commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Fetch and display the current JIRA user (verifies auth).

commands.name: show
commands.description: Print an issue from the local cache.

commands.name: config init
commands.description: Interactively write ~/.config/tendril/config.toml and store the API token.

commands.name: config show
commands.description: Print the current configuration (token is never printed).

commands.name: sync issue
commands.description: Fetch one or more JIRA issues and upsert them into the local cache.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: One or more JIRA issue keys.

commands.name: sync project
commands.description: Fetch every issue in one or more JIRA projects into the local cache.

parameters.name: project_keys
parameters.description: One or more JIRA project keys.

commands.name: sync incremental
commands.description: Refetch issues updated since the last incremental sync, across all previously synced projects.

commands.name: sync link-types
commands.description: Fetch the JIRA instance's issue link types and replace the local cache.

commands.name: watchlist add
commands.description: Add issue keys to the watchlist (idempotent).

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: One or more JIRA issue keys.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Optional note attached to each entry.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Optional tag applied to each key (repeat to add several).

commands.name: watchlist remove
commands.description: Remove issue keys from the watchlist. The cached issue rows are left alone.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: One or more JIRA issue keys.

commands.name: watchlist list
commands.description: Print the watchlist with cached issue metadata (run `sync watchlist` to populate).

commands.name: tag add
commands.description: Add tags to a cached issue (idempotent). Tags are local — never pushed to JIRA.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: One or more tags to add.

commands.name: tag remove
commands.description: Remove tags from a cached issue.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: One or more tags to remove.

commands.name: tag set
commands.description: Replace the full tag set for an issue. The bulk-write an LLM would use.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags to assign. Omit to clear all tags.

commands.name: tag list
commands.description: List tagged issues. `--json` for machine consumption (LLM pipelines).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Limit to one issue key. Omit to list all tagged issues.
